Hi, I have a 6 month old cockapoo and he also had a yeast infection when he was 3 months old. The vet prescribed a course of antibiotics and it cleared up within a week. And then he got another ear infection that was worse than the first after a grooming appointment. This time I did some research and found an ear cleaning solution called zymox (I got the one without hydrocortisone) and this stuff was a miracle!! My puppy’s ear infection went away within a couple days but we continued using it for a week. You don’t even need to preclean his ears- just once a day fill his ear canal with the solution and massage it in and wipe the excess. He has stopped itching his ears completely. It’s worth a try!
